question: A group of people consists of men, women and children. Among them, 20% are men, 30% are women and the rest are children, and their average weights are 50 kg, 40 kg and 40 kg, respectively. The average weight of the group (in kg) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Men** : **Women** : **Children** = 20 : 30 : 50 = 2 : 3 : 5.

Total weighted sum = (2 × 50) + (3 × 40) + (5 × 40) = 100 + 120 + 200 = 420.

Average weight of group = 420 ÷ (2 + 3 + 5) = 42 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of **Men** = 20%, **Women** = 30%.

Average weights: **Men** = 50 kg, **Women** = 40 kg, **Children** = 40 kg.

**Formula:**

Average Weight = (Total Weight of all People) ÷ (Total Number of People)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5504e8f394d215f8e7b348af6677c1d046f9cf55b68b4a5c3469ff839ee03e24.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Percentage of **Children** = 100% − (20% + 30%) = 50%

⇒ Let total number of people in the group = 100

⇒ Number of Men = 20, Women = 30, Children = 50

⇒ Total weight = (20 × 50) + (30 × 40) + (50 × 40)

⇒ Total weight = 1000 + 1200 + 2000 = 4200 kg

⇒ Average weight of the group = 4200 ÷ 100 = 42 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 42 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

It is the average of a data set where different values have different levels of importance or frequency. Formula: Average = (n₁w₁ + n₂w₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Deviation Method

Pick an assumed average (e.g., 40) and calculate the net deviation. Here, 20% are +10 above 40, so Net Deviation = 20 × 10 = 200. Final Average = 40 + (200 ÷ 100) = 42 kg.</p
